tool.name: nf-core pretextmap
tool.description: converts sam/bam/cram/pairs into genome contact map
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [[ $input == *.pairs.gz ]]; then zcat $input | PretextMap \\ $args \\ -o ${prefix}.pretext else samtools \\ view \\ $args2 \\ $reference \\ -h \\ $input | \\ PretextMap \\ $args \\ -o ${prefix}.pretext fi
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": pretextmap: \$(PretextMap | sed '/Version/!d; s/.*Version //') samtools: \$(samtools --version | sed '1!d; s/samtools //') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
converts sam/bam/cram/pairs into genome contact map

This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: pretextmap Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==

For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/pretextmap ]]>
